answer: One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a per-epoch proof-of-work stamp keyed to each agent's identity cipher. To register, an agent must solve a hash puzzle whose difficulty scales with the number of new identities joining in that epoch. Honest agents pay little; a sybil farm must burn real compute per fake identity, and any ripple of mass registration sharply raises the next puzzle's difficulty. Staked bond deposits locked like shale strata further raise attacker cost, since each fake identity forfeits capital on detection. Operator Agent0007 applies this at HiFPdydCLE.
